globalInvariants: One authoritative gameplay transition backend per edition
Oracle, engine trace and rendered trace are separate evidence
No prepared fixtures or assisted wins count as earned release routes
Original data and user saves remain preserved and separately scoped
Physical Android qualification cannot be replaced by a narrow desktop viewport

packets.title: Edition baselines and inventory
outputs: edition manifests with matching resource/script hashes
gates: Exact EGA source match established or explicit blocker
VGA baseline independently qualified
Working0.5.2 and current user saves preserved

packets.title: Minimum reusable tooling and backend proof
outputs: loop schema and source lookup tools
gates: Creation, cross-room quest, NPC sequence, parser and save/resume work
Modern render boundary and compiled tiny extension demonstrated
No partial-SCI/native-fallthrough authority

packets.title: Common state and resolved-scene boundary
gates: Renderer cannot independently grant story progress
Movement, target approach and action guards agree
Stale callbacks and missing source semantics fail explicitly

packets.title: One earned connected loop in each flavor
gates: Ordinary input earns cross-room payoff and survives revisit/save/reload
No grants, teleports or assisted combat
Edition oracle comparison and actual rendered input both pass

packets.title: Whole-game behavior and class alternatives
gates: All mandatory milestones through endings reachable by ordinary input
Consequential failures/recovery and repeat-reward checks pass
No room-count proxy for scene completeness

packets.title: Complete art, geometry and motion integration
outputs: art fingerprints and reviewed scene geometry
gates: Hero/major actors/locations prioritized
Masks, feet, perspective, hotspots and movement agree
Still images do not count as animation or full original cel parity

packets.title: Windows, actual Android, offline and recovery
gates: Actual supported Android input loops pass in both flavors
Unvisited scenes load without network after full offline install
Failed imports preserve active data/save; incompatible saves remain intact

packets.title: Prompt-created adventure qualification
gates: Fresh prompts produce coherent supported content without main-UI special cases
Standalone has its own start, progression and success/failure endings
Broken variants reject and compatible progress survives
Entry, payoff, return, save/resume and removal policy verified

packets.title: Final edition and creation release
gates: Required class routes and branch loops qualify on the frozen candidate
Device and packaged/offline release gates pass
Exact remaining limits and intentional deviations disclosed

checkpointPolicy: First two execution hours report evidence and reforecast. This is neither a completion deadline nor a stopping rule. No implementation batch is scheduled by this planning file.
externalDependencies: Qualified behavior backend and extension compilation path
Actual Android device/browser access for final device acceptance
